title: Luhn check for card numbers
summary: Strings as char arrays, walking an array backwards, validating input.
hints: First copy the digits into an `int digits[128]` array, skipping spaces. Return 0 as soon as you meet any other non-digit.
Walk from the last digit to the first with a position counter that starts at 0. Double the digit when the position is odd (the 2nd, 4th, ... from the right).
Guard the array: if there are more than 128 digits, return 0 instead of writing past the end. AddressSanitizer would catch you otherwise.
